# Typelessity — full content (llms-full.txt)

> Typelessity is an AI conversational booking widget that replaces traditional booking forms with natural-language chat. The chat window comes in 25 languages. Built by Webappski. This file concatenates the public pages for LLM ingestion. Last updated 2026-10-25.

---

## Home — https://typelessity.com/

**Hero.** Bookings through conversation, not forms. Typelessity is an AI booking widget that replaces forms with natural chat. Customers describe their needs in a chat window that comes in 25 languages — the AI extracts dates, times, preferences and personal details automatically; it replies in the language you set for the business. Voice input. Enrichment from your own APIs. Consent is asked before the chat starts; service and database in the EU, OpenAI in the US under the 2021 SCCs; processing under the Typelessity DPA.

**TL;DR.** Typelessity is an AI conversational booking widget that replaces multi-step forms with a single chat. Users describe their booking in plain language; the widget extracts structured data, validates it, calls enrichment APIs (e.g. fetch available mechanics after a service is chosen), and submits the booking request by email or REST POST. The chat window comes in 25 languages; it supports voice input and adapts to any business that takes bookings.

**Stats.** Chat-window languages 25. Free pilot €0, up to 50 submissions a month. Four phases (Chat → Select → Review → Confirm). Two lines of HTML to integrate.

**Four phases.**
1. Chat — User describes booking in plain language; The AI model — OpenAI (currently gpt-5.4-mini) — reads the field config and extracts values directly. No regex, no hardcoded patterns, no language switches.
2. Select — When options must be exact (a specific mechanic, a specific time slot), the widget renders interactive cards. Triggered by enrichment APIs.
3. Review — Full form review surface. User verifies every extracted field, edits inline if needed. Cascade-aware — changing a field clears downstream-dependent fields with a warning.
4. Confirm — Booking sent to your system: as JSON to your endpoint, shaped by the field mapping, or by email. The success screen shows a reference: the ID your system returned, or our own when it returned none. A 502, 503 or 504 from your endpoint is retried with exponential backoff.

**Architecture pillars.**
- Single unified prompt: one GPT call extracts every field. The prompt is built from the configuration, so its size grows with the fields and options.
- Config-driven, not pattern-driven: aiHint per field; GPT reads context.
- Enrichment APIs: 10 s timeout each by default (configurable), non-fatal on failure.
- Cascade-aware corrections: DFS dependency walk on field changes.
- Guardrails in code: fields the configuration does not define are dropped; a reply claiming a finished booking before confirmation is discarded; a new value for a filled field is treated as a correction. The `_meta.mf` mentioned-fields list is logged for diagnostics, not enforced.
- Reliable by design: exponential-backoff retries on model calls and on booking submission, semaphore-bounded concurrency for model calls, every message stored with its conversation.

**Comparison with other tools.** Use Typelessity when you have an existing booking system and want to replace its form with conversation. The facts about other vendors (Calendly, SimplyBook.me, Botpress, NoForm.ai) live in one article, each checked against the vendor's own pages and dated: [Best AI booking widgets for websites in 2026](https://typelessity.com/blog/best-ai-booking-widgets-2026).

---

## How it works — https://typelessity.com/how-it-works

Four phases, one unified flow. Chat → Select → Review → Confirm. One GPT call per turn, enrichment APIs, cascade-aware corrections, no hardcoded regex.

The widget is a Lit web component. The API is a Node service. The AI provider is OpenAI, called through Typelessity's own account; there is no custom provider option. Field schemas are JSON. Per-tenant config selects field types, options, enrichments, branding.

Embed: two lines of HTML — a `<script type="module">` tag loading https://typelessity-widget.vercel.app/widget.js and a `<typelessity-widget api-url="https://typelessity.vercel.app">` element. The embed code comes from your setup in the Webappski portal, which shows the exact code to paste into your page. Your site must use HTTPS.

---

## Install — https://typelessity.com/install

Set up Typelessity in the Webappski portal, paste two lines of HTML, and receive booking requests by email or straight into your booking system.

## Pricing — https://typelessity.com/pricing

The Free Pilot is open, and every tier starts with it: sign in at https://webappski.com/en/portal/login?start=typelessity and set Typelessity up in the portal — step by step, or with your own AI writing the configuration.

**Free Pilot — €0.** Up to 50 submissions/month, 1 website. Tiers differ in submission volume and the number of websites; voice input, enrichment APIs, custom branding and REST integration are included, with support by email. Risk-free evaluation on a real site.

**Starter — €39/mo.** Up to 500 submissions/month, up to 5 websites, support by email.

**Pro — €149/mo.** Up to 2,000 submissions/month, up to 10 websites, support by email.

**Enterprise — €399/mo.** Up to 6,000 submissions/month and unlimited sites. A named contact and pricing above 6,000 submissions are agreed per contract on request. No availability SLA in the standard terms yet; one becomes possible once the hosting plans support it. Hosted only — no on-premise or self-hosted build, no custom AI provider. Support by email, as on every tier.

We do not publish a conversion-lift number. The only honest answer for a specific business is an A/B test on its own traffic.

---

## Businesses — any business that takes bookings

Typelessity adapts to any business that takes bookings. Each business has its own configuration: the details the chat collects and the calls it makes. For example: hair salons, restaurants, yoga studios, driving schools, auto repair, gyms and tutoring.

Medical booking is not a supported use case: the Typelessity DPA does not permit health data (GDPR Article 9), in the US or the EU, and Typelessity is not HIPAA-attested.

---

## For AI agents — https://typelessity.com/for-ai-agents

The Session and Booking shapes are published, not versioned yet. A dedicated `/agent/turn` endpoint is designed on that page, but it is not built and has no release date.

**Session schema.** `{ id, configId, state, extractedData, createdAt, updatedAt, bookingResult }`.

**Booking schema.** `{ success, bookingId, outcome }` (outcome is `booking` or `request`).

**Feature list (machine-readable).**
- languages_supported: 25 (chat window; the assistant replies in the language set for the business)
- businesses_supported: any business that takes bookings (set up per business in config)
- extraction_model: OpenAI (currently gpt-5.4-mini)
- voice_input: OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-transcribe
- enrichment_timeout_ms: 10000 by default, configurable
- hosting_region: EU (Vercel fra1, Frankfurt)
- database_region: EU (Supabase eu-west-1, Ireland)
- ai_processing_region: US (OpenAI, 2021 SCCs)
- deployment: hosted only, no on-premise build
- training_use: none

Questions about the /agent endpoint: info@webappski.com.

## FAQ — https://typelessity.com/faq

Selection (full FAQ on /faq):

- **What is Typelessity?** AI conversational booking widget replacing multi-step booking forms with a single natural-language chat. Chat window in 25 languages, voice via OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-transcribe, enrichment APIs.
- **How is it different from other booking tools?** Typelessity replaces the booking form with a conversation, then submits to your existing backend or sends the request by email; it is not a booking platform. The per-vendor comparison (Calendly, SimplyBook.me, Botpress, NoForm.ai) is kept in one article with the date each page was checked: [Best AI booking widgets for websites in 2026](https://typelessity.com/blog/best-ai-booking-widgets-2026).
- **Who is the controller under GDPR?** You are the controller and Typelessity is your processor under a DPA. On our side: consent is asked from every visitor before the chat starts. Service in the EU (Vercel, Frankfurt), database in the EU (Supabase, Ireland); OpenAI and Resend process in the US under the 2021 SCCs. Abandoned conversations deleted within 48 hours; booked ones kept until the business has them erased (written instruction to info@webappski.com). OpenAI keeps conversation text up to 30 days for abuse checks. No model training.
- **Voice input?** Yes — OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-transcribe.
- **Per-turn latency?** Not measured on the current model, so not quoted. One AI call per turn; enrichment turns make a second call.
- **Self-host?** No. Hosted service only — there is no on-premise or self-hosted build.
- **Replace my booking system?** No. Replaces the form, not the backend. Submits by email or REST POST.
- **Which businesses is it for?** Any business that takes bookings; each business has its own configuration. Examples: hair salons, restaurants, yoga studios, driving schools, auto repair, gyms and tutoring.
- **Works for AI agents?** Not through a dedicated endpoint yet. Session and Booking schemas are published; the `/agent/turn` endpoint is designed, not built, with no release date.

## About — https://typelessity.com/about

Mission: replace the booking form with one sentence. Multi-step forms exist because old UI primitives could not parse natural language. They can now.

Founder: Alex Isa. Engineer turned founder. Started the Typelessity engine in January 2026 and took it from specification to the free pilot — single-call extraction architecture, config-driven enrichment, anti-hallucination guards, a chat window in 25 languages out of the box.

**Built by Webappski.** Typelessity is a product of Webappski — a small product studio building the next layer of AI-native interfaces for service businesses. Sister product: TypelessForm — the same conversational-data-collection thesis applied to general-purpose forms (lead capture, support intake, onboarding). Typelessity is the booking-specific surface; TypelessForm is the generic one.

Values: GPT decides, code orchestrates. Architecture is permanent, GTM is changeable. Numbers belong with sources. The widget is for humans and agents.

## Legal

The privacy notice for a visitor and Security are served from this domain. The contracts are published by Webappski, the parent company, and live on webappski.com — the typelessity.com paths for them are permanent redirects, not documents.

- Privacy notice for a visitor of this website — https://typelessity.com/privacy
- Security — https://typelessity.com/legal/security
- Terms of Service — https://webappski.com/en/legal/terms-typelessity
- Typelessity DPA, including the sub-processor list (Appendix B) — https://webappski.com/en/legal/dpa-typelessity
- Privacy notice for the question form on the pricing page — printed under the form at https://typelessity.com/pricing#start-pilot

Service in the EU (Vercel, Frankfurt) and database in the EU (Supabase, Ireland) for every customer; OpenAI and Resend process in the US under the 2021 SCCs. Consent is asked from every visitor before the chat starts. OpenAI keeps conversation text for up to 30 days to check for abuse, longer only where the law requires it or to protect its service or others from harm. No data is used for model training. Abandoned conversations are deleted within 48 hours of the last message; conversations that produced a delivery record (a booking request, an emailed request, or a failed or cancelled attempt) are kept until the business has them erased by written instruction to info@webappski.com. Until the next widget release, the widget asks Google Fonts (Google) for its typefaces as soon as it appears on your page, before the consent question; the visitor’s browser then sends Google its IP address and browser details. typelessity.com blocks that request with its Content-Security-Policy; your site blocks it only if its own policy does. Security reports: info@webappski.com.
